milestone: Collection — Manage Collection Gains Direct "Add Image"/"Add Graphic" Controls
slice: A real-usage follow-up to the just-shipped 6-phase Collection feature, delivered once the user actually started using it: 'manage collection is good way to connect through experience. manage collection should also be operatable individually without going into collection. i would like to add extra assets there.' Until now the ONLY way to reach Manage Collection at all was indirect -- create/select an Experience, switch it to Image/Graphics content mode, follow its own 'Manage Collection ->' bridge link -- since Collection's Phase 1 auto-registration hook only ever fires as a side effect of an Experience's own imageSrc/graphicSrc being set. _renderCollectionPanel() (tools/world-builder-v2/js/worldBuilderApp.js) gained a new .wb-collection-add-row -- '+ Add Image' / '+ Add Graphic' -- rendered even on a totally empty registry (inserted before the panel's own early-return on zero entries), each wiring the exact, unmodified _fileInputUpload/_storeUploadedAsset/AssetStore.put() upload chokepoint every existing Collection/Experience upload already uses straight into registerCollectionAsset(project, ref, {kind:'image'|'graphic'}) directly -- the identical registration function Phase 1's auto-hook already calls, just invoked straight from the panel instead of via an Experience's own property write -- with NO Experience ever touched by this path. New .wb-collection-add-row CSS (world-builder.css). The empty-state help text was reworded to reflect there are now two ways to reach Collection content. Verified via a new, dedicated Playwright suite (collection_directadd_verify.js, 19/19 assertions, zero unexpected console/page errors) driving the real UI end to end: both buttons render alongside the still-showing empty-state message with zero Collection entries; a real file upload via '+ Add Image' creates exactly one new entry with kind:'image', with the seeded Experience's own imageSrc/graphicSrc both confirmed completely untouched -- proving no Experience was involved at all; the new row renders with a real thumbnail, correct meta text, working rename input/availability checkbox/delete button -- indistinguishable from an Experience-sourced entry, confirming this reuses the exact same CRUD; a second real upload via '+ Add Graphic' adds a genuinely independent second entry with kind:'graphic'. Full regression: the existing Phase 1 (27/27), Phase 2 (28/28), Phase 3 (25/25), Phase 4 (17/17), and Phase 5 (30/30) Collection suites all pass completely unchanged, plus both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2, 30/30 each) -- confirming this addition touches neither the compile/validate/publish pipeline nor any other Collection surface. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Creator Governing Rules change; root Studio (Creator) and tools/world-builder/ (v1) are both completely untouched -- confined entirely to tools/world-builder-v2/js/worldBuilderApp.js and tools/world-builder-v2/css/world-builder.css.
